intent: An adaptive risk control: ask the user intent, the dominant behaviour pattern, whether MFA failed while a challenge was pending, and the composite risk score; deny by intent membership or MFA failure or a high score, then review/challenge/allow by score bands, with the composite risk as the primary question and the request/actor ids carried through.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 5 iterations
a choice question "intent" asks "Which user intent does this event match?"
a choice question "behaviour" asks "Which behaviour pattern dominates this event?"
a choice question "mfa_failed_pending" asks "Did MFA fail while a challenge was already pending?"
a score question "composite_risk" asks "Composite risk score 0-100"
label "DENY" when the answer to "intent" is one of "credential_stuffing", "card_testing", "account_takeover"
label "DENY" when the answer to "mfa_failed_pending" is "B"

unknown_steps.text: label "DENY" when the answer to "intent" is in "credential_stuffing", "card_testing"
label "DENY" when the answer to intent is one of "credential_stuffing"
label "DENY" when the answer "intent" is one of "credential_stuffing"
